When

what

most
important

when

where

study

of

campus

either

quite
'
or

very

8%

not
very

not
at
all

in

choice
.
This

the
fourth

factor
after
course
,
location
and
reputation
.
Estate
quality
increases
in
importance
once
a
student
has
chosen
a
university
,

it

of

,

importance

students

impact
